text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Have you seen the noticeboard yet? Even 
outside of races, everyone is... so very 
active in so many ways, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Your friends, the upperclassmen... They're 
all as dazzling as dahlias and orchids.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I... absolutely love this academy, which 
is just like a gorgeous bouquet of 
flowers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, to bring out such colorful 
individuality—"harmony" is essential."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If so, then—I want to be the baby's breath 
that supports the blooming flower.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who doesn't overshadow 
everyone's radiance, but rather brings it 
out... It's okay for someone like that to 
exist, right?
